text:
Carla Reyes: FYI Greenline (midmarket) flagged a usage spike and poor NPS after their 2nd-week onboarding. Customer said: 'costs spiking, prompts unpredictable' — they mentioned downgrading. Need a microenable + short-term plan. cc @Alyssa Kim
Alyssa Kim: On it. Do we have playbook for 'usage spike + downgrade threat'? I can offer a 2-week coaching + credits.
Mike O'Neill: I talked to the buyer yesterday; biggest pain is not understanding token patterns. Willing to keep plan if we reduce unit cost or show quick wins.
Jordan Patel: Suggest 1) one 30-min live session focused on prompt templates, 2) targeted eval on top 5 flows, 3) temp quota bump + rollback. I can do the eval if we get logs.
Carla Reyes: Good. Quick checklist: ask for sample prompts + which model variants they used, send invite for live session, propose 2-week credits. I'll draft outreach.
Alyssa Kim: Draft email (will send):
```
Hi Sam — quick note: we'd like to jump on 30m to tune prompts and give a 2-week credits boost while we run a short eval. Quick options: Tue 10am, Wed 3pm. Will that work?
``` 
Alyssa Kim: @Mike can you share the usage window and top endpoints? Also grant Jordan access to debug logs.
Mike O'Neill: Sharing now: https://internal.grafana/greenline/usage
Mike O'Neill: Gave Jordan read to logs. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: Found 2 flows with heavy prefix token repeat; can enable prefix caching and adjust batching per route. Estimate 15% unit cost drop. Will prepare patch.
Carla Reyes: If customer agrees, we'll run the live session and apply quick config. Add 'downgrade pause' step: offer 30-day hold on downgrade if we see improvement.
Alyssa Kim: Noted. I'll send calendar invite + the email now. Bringing in enable-bot to log the play.
enable-bot: Playbook logged: microenable_recovery -> owner=Carla Reyes -> plan_id=pm-7721
Carla Reyes: Thanks. Follow-ups: Mike to confirm endpoints (by EOD), Jordan to prod patch (24h), Alyssa to send outreach. I'll update CRM and schedule check-in 7 days after session.
Mike O'Neill: Confirmed endpoints: /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/chat. Sent EOD report.
Jordan Patel: Patch rolled to staging. Will monitor latency impact.
Carla Reyes: Great. If we don't see adoption rise in 7 days, escalate to AE for credit extension. :white_check_mark:
Alyssa Kim: Sam replied — prefers Wed 3pm. Sending invite.
Carla Reyes: Win. Closing loop here, will post results after the session.
